en: My template quality dropped / got paused

steps: Meta's message_template_quality_update webhook stores the rating (green / yellow / red / unknown) on the template; the Templates API returns it as `quality` and the assistant states it
No rating yet = shown as no rating, never as green
edgeCases: The payload field names follow Meta's documentation and have not been seen on live traffic yet (an unfamiliar score is stored as UNKNOWN)
A rating drop can lead Meta to pause the template: the status webhook then marks it PAUSED
gaps: No quality badge on the Templates screen yet: the assistant and the API show it
Only the webhook sets the rating: a sync from Meta does not backfill it
assistantNote: Say 'no rating yet' when quality is null; never claim a template is healthy because it has no rating
